trial_court: Court of Sh Nikhil Chopra, District Judge (Commercial)-02, South-East, Saket Courts, New Delhi CS (COMM):654/22
case_name: Opple Lighting India Pvt Ltd vs Mr. Harjit Singh Proprietor Of M/S H. S.

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Opple Lighting India Private Limited, Through its AR Mr. Sanjeev Kukreja
parties.respondent_defendant: Mr. Harjit Singh Proprietor of M/s H.S Marshal & Co.

facts_of_case: Opple Lighting India Private Limited claimed recovery of Rs. 60,61,340.19/- towards unpaid balance against supplies. Defendant used to purchase products from plaintiff and had outstanding amount due.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that the cheque was dishonoured.
legal_principles.held: He denied that the agreement dated 04.07.2016 was not completely executed between plaintiff and defendant.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not accept a deficient certificate under section 65B Indian Evidence Act.
legal_principles.held: He tendered the following documents in plaintiff's evidence: 1. Certificate under section 65B Indian Evidence Act as Ex.PW1/B (Objected to on the grounds of deficient certificate under section 65B Indian Evidence Act).

outcome.final_order: The judgment disposes off a commercial suit for recovery of Rs. 60,61,340.19/- towards unpaid balance against supplies.

use_for_drafting: drafting a commercial suit for recovery of unpaid balance
preparing a pleading in a contract dispute
